newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early morning trade on Wednesday, with the market still under selling pressure ahead of corporate book closings at the end of March.
However, brokers said the bottom seemed solid and a weaker yen against the dollar could prompt buying in export-oriented blue chips.
At 0026 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 6.98 points, or 0.04 percent, at 18,307.35, after briefly dipping to 18,248.95.
Its March futures were 50 points lower at 18,290.
